column1: Levels are referred to London Underground Datum
London Underground Datum is 100m below Ordnance Datum Newlyn
Railway track  in station platforms is ideally level but small gradients do occur
The level value given is an approximation of the level throughout the platform
Small variations to rail levels do occur due to settlement, rail wear, and track maintenance
The Ground Level Outside Station, is indicative and is the height above Ordnance Datum
